methodologyNotes: Covers full-size outdoor recreational trampolines sold as a complete unit (jumping mat, frame, and — where applicable — enclosure net) at a published US price. Includes spring, spring-free (fiberglass-rod), and springless (bungee/composite) backyard trampolines. Excludes mini rebounder/fitness trampolines, competition/gymnastic trampolines, and water/inflatable trampolines. Price is typical US MSRP or street price, USD, for the size named. shape is an enum: 'round', 'square', 'rectangular', or 'oval'. frameSizeFt is the nominal frame size in feet as a string (a single edge for square/round, or 'LxW' for rectangular). jumpingAreaSqFt is the usable jumping-surface area in square feet. springSystem is an enum for the bounce mechanism: 'steel-spring', 'fiberglass-rod', or 'bungee'. springCount is the number of steel springs (null for spring-free systems). springLengthIn is the individual spring length in inches (null for spring-free systems). maxUserWeightLbs is the manufacturer's rated maximum single-user weight in pounds. totalWeightCapacityLbs is the rated total/structural weight capacity in pounds. galvanizedFrame is a boolean for a rust-resistant galvanized-steel frame. warrantyYears is the length in years of the longest full (non-prorated) warranty term stated; null if only a prorated term is published. astmCertified is a boolean for compliance with ASTM trampoline safety standards (e.g. ASTM F381) as stated by the maker. Any spec not stated verbatim on a fetched manufacturer or retailer page is left null.

products.name: Springfree Jumbo Square (S155)
products.priceNote: US MSRP $2,499, listed verbatim on the official Springfree product page (shown as "$2499" and, in the compare table, "$2,499"). The corroborating retailer page (Recreation Unlimited) does not display a numeric retail price — it is hidden behind a "Found this product at a lower price?" price-match prompt — so the price is sourced from the manufacturer only.
products.provenance: The official Springfree product page confirms this is model S155 (its Specifications block is headed "S155") and states, verbatim: jumping mat 13 ft x 13 ft, jumping surface area 155 ft², Tested Max Weight Capacity 1500 lb, Single Jumper Weight Capacity 220 lb, springless composite mat rods used instead of springs, a durable galvanized steel frame, a 10-year warranty on all parts, ASTM F2225 & F381 certification, and a $2,499 price. The Recreation Unlimited retailer page corroborates the exact model (SKU: S155, "13' x 13' Jumbo Square S155"), repeating 155 sq ft mat area, 220 lbs jumper weight rating, a warranty table listing Rods (confirming the springless rod system) and a 10-year registered warranty; it shows no numeric price. totalWeightCapacityLbs uses the manufacturer's stated 1500 lb tested capacity (the retailer lists a lower 1100 lb "structural load capacity," but the manufacturer figure is taken as the primary source and appears verbatim there).

products.provenance: The official ACON US store page (us.acon24.com, operated by ACON's US distributor Distributacon Inc.) confirms model identity: the bundle's trampoline component is explicitly named "ACON Air 16 Sport HD Rectangular Trampoline" (now marketed as "ACON 16 HD"), and the page's Product Specs verbatim state a rectangular 17 x 9.8 ft frame, galvanized/black-powder-coated steel frame, 140 galvanized coil springs of 10 in length, a "CE /ASTM -certified weight limit: 330 lbs", frame tested to 1650 lb static, a 10-year frame warranty, and a complete-package price of $2,499.00 (list $2,798.00). The retailer National Wholesale Products corroborates the exact model ("Acon Trampoline Air 16 Sport HD ... Includes 10x17ft Rectangular Trampoline"), the 10x17 nominal size, "140 heavy duty 10 inch springs", and "Galvanized steel frame pipes inside and out". jumpingAreaSqFt is null because neither page discloses a usable jumping-surface area in square feet (only mat dimensions 171x86in), and releaseDate is null because no release year is stated.

products.name: Vuly Thunder Pro (Large)
products.priceNote: No US MSRP is published for this exact model. The official Vuly Store Amazon listing shows "Currently unavailable / No featured offers available" (no price), the ProTrampolines review cites no dollar figure, and vulyplay.com's original Thunder Pro URL now redirects to the successor Thunder 2 Pro. Left null rather than guessed.
products.provenance: The official Vuly Store Amazon listing confirms this exact model — "Thunder Pro Springless Trampoline," offered in Large 14FT and Extra Large 16FT — and states verbatim: round shape, patented Leaf Spring (springless) technology, double-galvanized steel frame, 330 lb maximum weight recommendation, and a 10-year warranty on the frame. The ProTrampolines dated review (Jan 2022) corroborates the model and explicitly lists its sizes as M (12ft), L (14ft), XL (16ft), fixing "Large" = 14ft, and repeats the 330 lb limit, leaf springs, and twice-galvanized frame. I used the Vuly Amazon storefront as the source because vulyplay.com's original Thunder Pro page now redirects to the successor Thunder 2 Pro; no US MSRP appears on any fetched page (Amazon shows "Currently unavailable"), so priceUsd is null. springCount is null because the review's "56" is tied to its 12ft review unit (it notes the larger size has ~70), so no verbatim spring count exists for the Large specifically.

products.name: Skywalker 15' Round Trampoline
products.priceNote: Manufacturer's listed price on the official Skywalker Trampolines product page for the "15' Round Trampoline" (SKU SWOP15-B), shown verbatim as "Sale price $398.00". No separate regular/MSRP figure is displayed on the page (the regular-price field is blank).
products.provenance: The official Skywalker Trampolines product page (SKU SWOP15-B, titled "15' Round Trampoline") confirms this exact current model and states verbatim: a recommended individual user weight limit of 275 lbs, a 1,100 lbs weight capacity, a rust-resistant galvanized steel frame, that it meets ASTM (American Society of Testing Materials) standards, a 3-year limited frame warranty (1-year on mat/springs/poles), and a listed "Sale price $398.00". Retailer/review pages found for a "Skywalker 15' round" (Academy ITEM SWTC1500 with 200 lb capacity/96 springs/6.5" springs/1-year frame warranty, and the ProTrampolines "Jump N' Dunk" review, also 200 lb) describe a DIFFERENT configuration than SWOP15-B, so they were deliberately NOT used as corroboration to avoid cross-contaminating specs — hence corroboration is null. Spring count, spring length, and jumping-area square footage are not disclosed on the manufacturer page for this model and are left null rather than borrowed from the differing SKU.

products.name: Zupapa 1500LBS Saffun 15FT
products.priceNote: Manufacturer store zupapa.us lists "Sale price $649.99" for the Zupapa 1500LBS Saffun 15FT (blue); no separate compare-at/MSRP shown. For context, the same store's purple 15FT variant lists "Sale price $499.99 / Regular price $559.99" and the ProTrampolines review shows an Amazon price of $569.99 — figure used is the manufacturer's own listed price.
products.provenance: The Zupapa official store page titled "Zupapa 1500LBS Saffun Trampoline With Enclosure Net 15FT" confirms this exact 15FT Saffun model and states a sale price of $649.99, a 425 lb max weight capacity for the 15' size, a hot-dip galvanized frame, ASTM certification, and a 10-year frame warranty; the 1500LBS static capacity appears verbatim in the product name. The dated ProTrampolines review of the "Zupapa Trampoline 15ft Round" corroborates the round shape and adds spring detail not on the manufacturer page — "108 galvanized springs" at "7 inches each" — while independently repeating the 425 lb limit and 10-year frame warranty. A same-model purple 15FT variant on the manufacturer store also repeated the 1500LBS / 425 lb / ASTM / 10-year figures, confirming model identity across pages. jumpingAreaSqFt left null because no page discloses a mat area (only frame size).

products.name: JumpFlex HERO 15ft
products.priceNote: Official Jumpflex USA product page lists the RRP (MSRP) as $1,299, shown as "$999 $1,299" with "* RRP as at July 8, 2026"; the unit is currently on summer sale at $999. Used the $1,299 RRP as the US MSRP.
products.provenance: The official Jumpflex USA product page (jumpflex.com/products/hero-15ft-trampoline) confirms this exact model — the HERO 15ft round, "15 ft diameter" with a "Jumping mat diameter 13.1 ft" — and publishes a full spec table: "Number of springs 96", "Spring length 7.1 in", "Total weight rating 550 lb", "Max individual user weight 350 lb", a 10-year frame warranty, and "Built to global safety certification standards: ASTM & CE"; metal components are stated as "galvanized inside and out." Price on that page is the RRP (MSRP) of $1,299 ("$999 $1,299", "RRP as at July 8, 2026"), currently discounted to $999. The dated ProTrampolines 2026 review corroborates the 15ft variant in its size table (96 springs, ~15.1 ft footprint) and confirms shared HERO specs: ~7.1 in springs, the 550 lb structural / 350 lb per-jumper split, galvanized DualRing frame, and the 10-year frame warranty. Jumping-mat area is not disclosed (only the 13.1 ft mat diameter), so jumpingAreaSqFt is left null rather than derived.

products.name: JumpKing Pro-Series 10'x18' Rectangle (JKRC1018HEC3)
products.priceNote: bouncytrampolines.com lists model JKRC1018HEC3 at "Regular price $1,999.00" (currently "$1,795.00 On Sale"). Used the regular list price $1,999.00 as the typical US price.
products.provenance: The fetched bouncytrampolines.com page states "Item Number: JKRC1018HEC3" and "Model Number: JKRC1018HEC3" verbatim, confirming this is the exact model and not the raised-leg V2 sibling (JKRC1018HEC3V2), which the justtrampolines page shows with different specs (Max Load 400 lbs, height 35.43"). That page supplies the price (Regular $1,999.00 / on sale $1,795.00) and every non-null spec verbatim: 128 springs (120 @ 8.5" + 8 @ 5.5"), 128.5 sq ft jumping surface, rust-resistant galvanized steel frame, "Maximum weight capacity is 260 lbs", a 5-year frame warranty, and a statement that the product is tested to and meets ASTM standards. JumpKing's own product URLs for this exact HEC3 model return HTTP 404 and its live 10x18 catalog now lists only the different JKRC1018V3 variant, so no working manufacturer page was available; corroboration is null because the only other reachable 10x18 Pro listings were the differing V2 variant.

products.name: Plum Space Zone II Evolution 12ft
products.priceNote: Walmart US product page lists "Current price is USD $340.00" for the Plum 12ft Space Zone II Evolution Springsafe Trampoline & Enclosure (accessed 2026-07-11). No manufacturer US MSRP is published on the Plum site; this US retail price is used as the typical US price.
products.provenance: The Plum manufacturer page (plumplay.co.uk, Space Zone II Evolution) confirmed the model line and model-general facts: shape "Circular" (round), a steel frame "galvanised inside and out," Springsafe 3G enclosure with zinc-coated coil springs (spring loading tool provided), a 5-year frame warranty "against failure due to rusting," minimum user age 6+, and EN71-1/2/3/8/14 certification (no ASTM F381 claim anywhere, so astmCertified is false). The Walmart US retailer page confirmed the exact 12ft variant — "Plum 12ft Space Zone II Evolution Springsafe Trampoline & Enclosure," galvanized steel frame, assembled dimensions L144 x W144 in (= 12 ft diameter), and "Maximum user weight: 275lbs" — and provided the US price, stating "Current price is USD $340.00." warrantyYears uses the manufacturer's frame-specific 5-year figure; Walmart separately lists a shorter 1-year bundled US warranty, and jumping-area, spring count/length, and total weight capacity were not disclosed on either page (left null).
